     - Gary Clark Jr. contributed guitar and co-writing.
     - Jeff Bhasker and Salaam Remi are well-known producers/writers.

   - Keep it concise and accurate.
   - Add a note about the common misnomer "This Girl Is On Fire" vs actual title "Girl on Fire".

     - Jeff Bhasker – writer, producer, keyboards
     - Salaam Remi – writer, producer, instruments
     - Gary Clark Jr. – writer, guitar
     - Billy Squier – writer (drum sample from "The Big Beat")

   • Alicia Keys  
   • Jeff Bhasker  
   • Salaam Remi  
   • Gary Clark Jr.  
   • Billy Squier（因歌曲使用了其1980年作品〈The Big Beat〉的經典鼓點節奏而掛名）  

   製作人同樣由 Alicia Keys、Jeff Bhasker 與 Salaam Remi 共同擔任。若您需要更詳細的版權或編曲資訊，也可以告訴我！

6.  **Final Check:**

   - Correct composers? Yes, verified.

   - Tone? Helpful, precise.
   - No overcomplication. Ready.✅
   - Output matches response.✅
